[[Thul The Bull]] is often accompanied by two fairly sized groups of [[Stone Summit Ranger]]s and [[Stone Summit Carver|Carvers]].

==Location==
*[[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
**{{NPC location|Spearhead Peak}} (Directly north of [[Copperhammer Mines]])

==Skills==
*{{skill icon|Ferocious Strike}} ([[elite]])
*{{skill icon|Melandru's Assault}}
*{{skill icon|Tiger's Fury}}
*{{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}
*{{monster skill icon|Charm Animal (monster skill)}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Stone Summit Badge]]

==Notes==
*Unlike most other bosses with a monster skill version of Charm Animal, the regular version can't be captured from Thul The Bull.
*Thul The Bull spawns close to a level 15 [[Elder Wolf]] and can charm it if one of the nearby Stone Summit Rangers doesn't charm it first. He's unable to use his pet attacks without a pet.
